test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The new entrant in the class __**felt uncomfortable** __as all were unfamiliar to him.

options.text: Buried his head in the sand

solution: The correct answer is **"Was fish out of water."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Fish out of water"** means to feel uncomfortable or out of place in a new or unfamiliar situation. (किसी नई या अपरिचित स्थिति में असहज या जगह से बाहर महसूस करना) • **Example**: *I just always felt like a **fish out of water**__.* • In the given sentence, the new entrant in the class felt uncomfortable as he was unfamiliar to everyone else, making him a fish out of water. • This idiom is commonly used in situations where someone is not accustomed to a particular environment or social setting. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Left out in the cold"** means to be excluded or ignored by others. (दूसरों द्वारा बहिष्कृत या उपेक्षित किया जाना) • **"Was not given a fig"** means to not care at all about something. (किसी चीज़ की बिल्कुल भी परवाह न करना) • **"Buried his head in the sand"** means to ignore or avoid a problem or difficult situation. (किसी समस्या या कठिन परिस्थिति को नज़रअंदाज करना या टालना) 41:Tb60, The correct answer is** "I was laughed at by Ramya."**
